raw_text: Fact Check: Chinese State Media Uses Old Manipur Footage in New Disinformation Push. Reuters has verified that several video clips shared by Chinese state media outlets CGTN and Global Times purporting to show fresh ethnic violence in India's Manipur state are actually recycled footage from May 2023. The coordinated campaign, which included identical framing across multiple state outlets, appears designed to portray India as a failing multi-ethnic state amid broader Sino-Indian geopolitical tensions.
clean_text: Reuters verified Chinese state media using recycled May 2023 Manipur footage in new disinformation campaign. Coordinated identical framing across CGTN and Global Times designed to portray India as failing state.
